name: notion-knockoff-qa-automation
description: E2E automation for the Notion-clone workspace app (Playwright + POM + Allure), built from the AI-Driven Automation Framework template.

scripts.test: rm -rf allure-results && (npx playwright test; node analyst/run-analyst.js; npm run allure)
scripts.test:smoke: rm -rf allure-results && npx playwright test --project=chromium tests/smoke-tests && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.test:regression: rm -rf allure-results && npx playwright test --project=chromium tests/regression && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report --port 3030
